# ClipForge AI

> AI video clipping studio: turn a long video into ready-to-publish vertical
> clips for Shorts, Reels and TikTok. Upload once, get cut, captioned and
> framed clips back.

Live app: https://clip.viralcuts.live
API: https://api.clip.viralcuts.live (OpenAPI at /docs)

## What it does

- Transcribes the source video and scores its moments, then cuts the strongest ones.
- Reframes to 9:16 and burns captions in a chosen style.
- Renders each clip on its own, downloadable as MP4 with a thumbnail.
- Brand kits and templates to keep captions and colours consistent across clips.

## What it is not

- Not a full timeline editor: cuts are per clip, not frame-by-frame on a timeline.
- No YouTube or Vimeo URL import — upload the file, or give a direct file URL.

## Access

Account required (free registration). Rendering runs on a background worker,
so long videos are processed asynchronously.
